# MERN Stack Assignments - Harkirat Singh's Web Development Cohort

## 📌 Introduction
This repository contains all my MERN stack assignments from Harkirat Singh's web development cohort. I will be uploading the assignments week-wise as I progress through the cohort.

## 🚀 Structure
Assignments are organized based on weekly progress:


## 🛠️ Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js
- **Database**: MongoDB
- **Other Tools**: Git, GitHub, VS Code

## 📖 How to Use
1. Clone this repository:
   ```sh
   git clone <repo-link>
   cd Week-1/assignment-1
   npm install
   npm start```

- This repository will be updated regularly with new assignments.
